name: clusage
description: Real-time Claude Code usage tracking - cost, tokens, and live quota in your status bar and a beautiful dashboard.

enumDescriptions: Cost, percentages and the 5h reset countdown. Example: $12.30  5h:40% 2h 10m  7d:22%
Cost with a progress bar per quota window. Example: $12.30  5h ###--- 40%  7d #----- 22%. Reset times move to the tooltip.
Cost only. Example: $12.30. Quota stays in the tooltip.
clusage.statusBar.format.markdownDescription: How the status bar item is rendered. Every variant keeps the full breakdown in the hover tooltip.

clusage.statusBar.barWidth.markdownDescription: Width, in characters, of each quota bar. Only applies when `#clusage.statusBar.format#` is `bar`.

clusage.statusBar.showResets.markdownDescription: Show each quota window's reset countdown beside the window it belongs to. In `bar` mode this adds both the 5h and 7d countdowns, bracketed after their labels (bar drops them for space by default); in `compact` mode it adds the 7d countdown next to the 5h one that is always shown.

clusage.statusBar.showTodayTokens.markdownDescription: Show today's total token count next to the cost in the status bar (e.g. `$12.30 · 1.2M`). Applies to every format.

clusage.statusBar.colorOnHighUsage.markdownDescription: Tint the status bar amber once either quota window passes 70%, and red past 90%. Turn this off to keep the status bar in the theme's usual colour at any usage — the percentages and bars still say where you are, without the item changing colour to get your attention.

clusage.sessions.showTitles.markdownDescription: Label rows in the dashboard's **Sessions** tab with the conversation title Claude Code records in the transcript, falling back to the project name when a session has no title yet. Turn off to always show the project name.
